data.one_liner: Dart client for Supabase, usable in non-Flutter Dart environments.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to query and modify Supabase databases, manage authentication, and interact with realtime, storage, and functions services. It supports REST, realtime streams, and auth flows.
use_when: You need a pure Dart client for Supabase in server-side or command-line apps
You want to avoid Flutter-specific dependencies
You need realtime updates or storage access in a non-Flutter context
avoid_when: You are building a Flutter app (use supabase_flutter instead)
You need advanced code generation or UI widgets
strengths: Supports realtime, auth, storage, and functions
weaknesses: No UI widgets or Flutter integration
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import 'package:supabase/supabase.dart'; no build_runner needed

alternatives.name: supabase_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Flutter widgets and easier setup for Flutter apps
